items.title: No-nonsense magistrate slams 10 years on another rapist in Basse
items.summary: By Amadou Jadama The Basse Magistrate’s Court has sentenced one Omar Jallow to a mandatory jail term of 10 years with hard labour after he admitted and was subsequently found guilty of raping a 19-year-old girl in Basse. Senior Magistrate Ismaila Dibba further ordered the conv...
